about: Image bytes per built env at sha, measured by check_image_size.py --record-baseline: image_bytes is firmware.bin, docs_pack_bytes is the docs pack read from firmware.elf (the tables named in docs_pack_tables plus every string they point at, merged literals once), code_bytes is the difference. A lane's code delta against this row must be at most its allowance in image_budget.d/<lane>.json. Re-recorded after each merge into the integration branch, on the merge commit, so the next lane is measured against the line it joins.
